title: Speaking — Objects with memories
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on objects with memories.

questions: What do you like about the room you use most?
Is there a part of your home you rarely use?
How long have you lived in your current home?
What would you put in a room of your own?
Do you keep souvenirs from special occasions?
Where do you keep things that remind you of people?

part2.topic: Describe an ordinary object that has a special meaning to you.
points: how you came to have it
part2.closing: and explain why you decided to keep it.

questions: Can digital records carry the same significance as physical possessions?
Which possessions can tell historians the most about daily life?
How has everyday life connected with objects with memories changed for people of different ages?
